# Ascaya Henderson

> Dr. Jan Duffy, REALTOR®, represents buyers and sellers at Ascaya in Henderson, Nevada.

Canonical: https://www.ascayahenderson.com
Community: One Ascaya Blvd, Henderson, NV 89012
Office: 9406 W Lake Mead Blvd, Suite 100, Las Vegas, NV 89134
Client phone: (702) 222-1964
License: S.0197614.LLC
Brokerage: Berkshire Hathaway HomeServices Nevada Properties
Hours: Monday–Friday 9:00 AM–6:00 PM, Saturday 10:00 AM–4:00 PM, Sunday by appointment

Ascaya is a guard-gated residential community in the McCullough Mountain Range, about 20 minutes from the Las Vegas Strip. Offerings are The Canyon Residences (51 condominiums by Blue Heron), Desert Design Study homes, and Estate and Cloud Rock homesites. Community facts were checked against https://www.ascaya.com/ on 2026-10-08. Prices change. This site does not publish a single Ascaya home value.
